target.statement: Test R² of the final XGBoost model (Model 2) for compressive strength prediction, reported as 0.94 in Table 8.
target.table_ref: Table 8, Compressive strength, Model 2, Testing, R2
target.dataset: UHPC compiled database (1,201 data points from 19 literature sources, 17 input features)

compute.basis: The dataset is not public (available only on request) and must be reconstructed from 19 papers via plot digitization; the ML training itself (XGBoost on ~1200 rows) takes seconds on CPU, so the estimate is dominated by data collection and cleaning.

blockers: Dataset not released: 'Data will be made available on request'
No code repository or configuration files provided
Data must be manually extracted from 19 literature sources using WebPlotDigitizer
Exact train/test split and random seed not specified, so exact R² cannot be guaranteed even with data
title: A Data-Driven Multi-Objective Approach for Predicting Mechanical Performance, Flowability, and Porosity in Ultra-High-Performance Concrete (UHPC)
